verdict.rationale: Mercury Command is a built-in AI assistant that answers questions grounded in account data and surfaces suggestions like GL codes, categorization rules, and journal entries directly inside Mercury Books, and AI-driven GL code suggestions are cited as a concrete insight feature. This is first-party vendor documentation only, with no independent/hands-on corroboration of quality or accuracy, and the company itself cautions automation has limits (not full 'autopilot'). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of Command's insight quality, and evidence of breadth/depth of proactive suggestions beyond categorization and Q&A.
